audit_items.proof_trace: The `public.announcements` table has RLS enabled; all mutating operations (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) are gated by the policy `Allow admin to manage announcements` which applies `public.is_admin()` in both USING and WITH CHECK clauses (L159). `public.is_admin()` (L131-138) checks `public.users.role = 1`, and a non-admin user cannot self-elevate that role because the update policy on `public.users` itself requires `public.is_admin()` (L147-148). No application-level server actions for announcement CRUD exist, so direct database enforcement is the sole — and sufficient — enforcement layer.
